title: BC Friday Tips #81 Keep BCContainerHelper Up to Date
summary: BCContainerHelper is a PowerShell module for Business Central container workflows. Keeping it updated ensures you get the latest bug fixes and performance improvements that may resolve container issues.
key_points: Use Update-Module -Name BCContainerHelper to get the latest version
Older installed versions can be removed with PowerShell scripts to clean up your system
New releases fix bugs and improve container performance
Update before troubleshooting container issues, as the problem may already be fixed

quotes.text: New releases can improve performance and fix bugs in your container workflows.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key benefit of staying current with BCContainerHelper updates

quotes.text: Update your BCContainerHelper version before troubleshooting a strange container issue. It might already be fixed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides practical guidance for troubleshooting container problems by ensuring you have the latest fixes
